categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-performance sintered NdFeB (neodymium-iron-boron) permanent magnetic materials, rubber magnets, and other magnetic products. It also provides related technical services. The main product lines include high-performance sintered NdFeB magnets and magnetic components used in automotive, industrial motor, and high-end consumer electronics sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies covering the entire production process of sintered NdFeB magnets, including alloy preparation, powder metallurgy, molding, sintering, performance testing, machining, grain boundary diffusion, and surface treatment. Key proprietary technologies include grain boundary doping and diffusion control, atmosphere control, powder surface modification, and green, efficient surface protection coatings. The company also focuses on green remanufacturing technologies for recycling waste NdFeB magnets and has developed advanced processes for low heavy rare earth and no heavy rare earth magnets.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are manufacturers in the automotive industry (notably new energy vehicles), industrial motors, and consumer electronics sectors. The company supplies major domestic and international clients such as German automotive suppliers (ZF, Schaeffler), Chinese new energy vehicle makers (BYD, Chery), and industrial motor manufacturers (Siemens, Midea). The products are widely used in automotive EPS systems, new energy vehicle drive motors, energy-saving motors, robotics, wind power, 3C electronics, and 5G communications equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Hefei, Baotou, Ningguo, Suzhou, and Shanghai. It also has subsidiaries and sales offices in Germany and Japan, serving both domestic and international markets. Domestic sales account for about 68% of revenue, with overseas sales growing steadily through direct sales and distributor channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the rare earth permanent magnet supply chain, focusing on manufacturing high-performance sintered NdFeB magnets from rare earth alloy raw materials. It has strategic upstream partnerships and equity stakes in rare earth alloy suppliers to secure raw material supply, and it sells finished magnetic materials and components downstream to motor and equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-performance sintered NdFeB magnet technologies with reduced heavy rare earth content, green surface protection, and recycling of waste magnets. The company invests heavily in R&D, operating national key laboratories and innovation centers, and undertakes numerous state and provincial research projects. Future R&D focuses on improving magnetic performance, thermal stability, low-cost magnet production, and expanding applications in new energy vehicles, robotics, and low-altitude aircraft.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of sintered NdFeB magnets, rubber magnets, and other magnetic products. The company uses a direct sales model predominantly, supplemented by distributor sales especially for overseas markets. It also earns income from technical services and licensing related to its proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer of high-performance sintered NdFeB magnets with strong brand recognition and technological capabilities. It holds key industry positions as a member and vice-chair of rare earth industry associations. Competitors include other Chinese rare earth magnet producers and international magnet manufacturers, but the company differentiates itself through advanced technology, stable raw material supply, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.32 billion, a 7.79% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to lower rare earth raw material prices and pricing pressure. It returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 31.87 million, reversing prior losses. Total assets grew by 9.92% to RMB 2.54 billion. The company maintains steady R&D investment at about 5.78% of revenue and has expanded production capacity with new projects completed.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high magnetic performance, thermal stability, and low heavy rare earth content in its sintered NdFeB magnets, meeting stringent quality and environmental standards. Its proprietary grain boundary diffusion and green surface protection technologies enhance product durability and performance. The company also offers green recycling solutions for waste magnets, supporting sustainability. Its strong customer service, stable raw material supply chain, and national innovation platforms provide competitive advantages.
